about_the_game:
BLOK is a first-person psychological horror game set in a Polish neighbourhood in the 1990s.

Years after fleeing the country for political reasons, you return to your old apartment block,  brought back by a strange letter from your mother. The neighborhood seems to be the same. But something is not right. It is almost too perfect. And the more you search the more cracks you find.

Explore the neighborhood, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth shaped by fear, silence, and control. Traces of life under a regime based on secrecy and repression. As you investigate, the world subtly transforms around you.

BLOK offers:

First-person atmospheric exploration in retro aesthetics that perfectly fit the tone and memories of 90s eastern european neighbourhood.

Story-driven gameplay with environmental storytelling that touches on life under a regime and historical events

Meaningful puzzles integrated into the narrative and the story

Changes in space and tone as the story and the mystery unfolds

Hauntingly familiar yet nostalgic world inspired by post-communist Poland

Customization of a "retro" look. Adjust pixelation, color precision etc. in the settings

The story doesn’t tell you everything. It lets you find it. Hidden in walls, staircases, basement and buried in layers of memories and silence.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes related to psychological trauma, state oppression, and totalitarian regimes. It includes disturbing imagery, emotional distress, and scenes that may be unsettling to some players. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: BLOK is a psychological horror game set in 1990s Poland. You play as a former dissident who fled the country in the '80s during the communist regime. Years later, after the fall of the system, a strange letter from your mother brings you back to your old home. But something is deeply wrong.
